column1: # daemon_hold_ack.tsv -- deliberate holds on the DAEMON RECENCY link.
# Consumed by scripts/verify_cut_freshness.sh (check_daemon_recency). Mirrors
# the contract in wiki_hold_ack.tsv, and applies to the RECENCY link ONLY. The
# four provenance links (tag -> published release -> .sha256 sidecar ->
# build-info commit) are NEVER waivable: a break there means the installer
# downloads bytes nobody can account for.
# TAB-separated. Four columns:
#   1. pinned_sha_prefix           prefix of the daemon commit the hold covers.
#                                  A re-pin invalidates the row on purpose, so
#                                  the decision has to be made again.
#   2. hold_ack_shas               EVERY commit in pin..oa-main, space- or
#                                  comma-separated. Short shas are fine; the
#                                  match is prefix-tolerant in both directions.
#                                  ANY unlisted delta commit is RED.
#   3. shipping_bugfixes_grafted   must be exactly `true`. An explicit human
#                                  assertion that nothing held back is a
#                                  shipping bugfix a customer needs.
#   4. reason                      why the pin is held. Empty reason is RED.
# THIS FILE IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY OF ROWS.
# It is not an oversight and it must not be pre-populated to make a cut go
# green. The gap it exposes on 2026-08-12 is real: CM051 pins hub-v0.4.54 @
# 782a6195 while ostler-ai/ostler-assistant main is 10b003a0, 29 commits ahead,
# and those 29 commits contain the WhatsApp channel work. The correct response
# is to cut a daemon release that CONTAINS them and re-pin -- not to write a
# row here. A hold is for a commit you have consciously decided a customer does
# not need yet; it is not a way to silence the gate.
# pinned_sha_prefix
f1c7c57d
column4: v1.0.48 (2026-08-28 TNM). Delta from the pinned f1c7c57d (hub-v0.4.67) to oa main is exactly TWO commits and NEITHER is a shipping bugfix, MEASURED per-commit with git show --name-only rather than read off the titles. 2e8914fe is oa #365, a CI cadence change; 922fe263 is oa #364, a self-test for shipped_fixes_gate, test-only. Both were merged by me on 2026-08-27, which is why this gate re-redded: it re-enumerates the delta against live HEAD and finds shas it has not been told about. That is the gate working, not failing. NO BUGFIX IS HELD, which is what shipping_bugfixes_grafted asserts. WHY HOLD RATHER THAN RE-PIN: re-pinning the daemon is an ARTEFACT pin, not a subtree pin, so it forces a daemon rebuild and republish (board #467: 21 crates/ and 16 web/ files reach the artefact) to absorb zero customer-facing change. CARRY FORWARD: both commits ride the next daemon build, and this row must be DELETED rather than renewed at that point. v1.0.49 EXTENSION (2026-08-28 A2). The delta grew from TWO commits to SEVEN, and all five additions are oa #366, rebase-merged at 04:27:45Z DURING this cut. Rebase renamed every sha, so the PR's own commits (ea53b973 e45b852f b512029f 283e0b81 524f2535) landed as 5a059be5 8bf6cdec 3464215b c2996871 d9ea32dd; attributed per-commit with `gh api repos/.../commits/<sha>/pulls`, which returns #366 for all five, NOT read off titles. CRATES/ REACH, MEASURED PER COMMIT: 5a059be5 0, 8bf6cdec 0, c2996871 0 (scripts/ci and workflow only); 3464215b 1 file; d9ea32dd 2 files. BOTH crates/ commits are TEST-ONLY, established by locating their hunks inside `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (lines 6192..12777 of crates/zeroclaw-channels/src/orchestrator/mod.rs, zero production lines changed) and by the Cargo.toml tokio test-util feature sitting under [dev-dependencies]. NO BUGFIX IS HELD, so shipping_bugfixes_grafted stays true. SAME HOLD-NOT-REPIN REASONING as above: re-pinning is an ARTEFACT pin and would force a rebuild and re-notarisation of a launch candidate to absorb a paused-clock test fixture. CARRY FORWARD: all seven ride the next daemon build and this row is DELETED, not renewed, at that point.

v1.0.59 (2026-09-02 Archie). Delta from the pinned bc63c445 (hub-v0.4.70) to oa main is EXACTLY ONE COMMIT and it is not a shipping change of any kind, MEASURED per-commit via the compare API rather than read off the title: 4ebf1e1f is 'chore(gitignore): ignore local release-build artefacts at the repo root', 1 file, +16/-0, and the single file is .gitignore. || ARTEFACT-LEVEL CONTROL, NOT AN ARGUMENT FROM THE FILENAME: the published hub-v0.4.70 tarball was downloaded and listed -- 52 entries, ZERO of them .gitignore. A rule that governs what git ignores in a working copy is not compiled, not include_str!'d and not shipped, so the held commit provably cannot reach a customer. || WHY .gitignore IS NOT SIMPLY DENYLISTED AS INERT: path_is_inert() covers .github/**, docs/** and *.md only, and its own header says it FAILS CLOSED -- anything not explicitly known-inert keeps the daemon RED. That is correct behaviour and I am not widening a gate during the cut it is judging; a one-commit hold is the narrower instrument and it expires by construction. || WHY HOLD RATHER THAN RE-PIN: the daemon pin is an ARTEFACT pin. Re-pinning forces a full rebuild, re-sign, re-notarise and re-publish of a launch candidate to absorb a .gitignore rule, and the rebuilt binary would differ from the one already measured at WRAPPER_FRONTEND_COMMIT=bc63c445. || SELF-INFLICTED, AND RECORDED AS SUCH: 4ebf1e1f is my own Clean House commit, merged into the daemon repo at 08:03:55Z, DURING this cut window. That is precisely the lesson the v1.0.55 rollforward row records -- merging upstream inside a cut window advances the live HEAD the pins are measured against, so the cut's own inputs go stale under it. Merging upstream during a cut is not free. || CARRY FORWARD: 4ebf1e1f rides the next daemon build and this row must be DELETED, not renewed, at that point.

2026-09-06 (Archie, v1.0.73). ONE delta commit, and it CANNOT CHANGE THE BUILT BINARY -- measured per file rather than inferred from its title. 82ab1703 'test(#383): six test files ran nowhere, and now a gate says so' touches exactly two files: .github/workflows/ci.yml and release/test_every_test_file_is_executed_or_declared.sh. THE DISCRIMINATING COUNT: of its changed files, the number matching ^crates/.*[.]rs$ or ^Cargo[.](toml|lock)$ is ZERO. Those are the paths the pre-tag daemon-freshness row itself uses to decide whether a change reaches the binary, so this is the project's own predicate rather than one I invented. A CI workflow and a test-wiring script are not compiled into the daemon and are not shipped in its tarball. shipping_bugfixes_grafted is true honestly: there is no bugfix in it at all, let alone one held back from a customer -- it is a gate that makes six previously dark test files run. SCOPE: covers 82ab1703 only. A later daemon commit reds this row again, and a re-pin invalidates it by design.

2026-10-09 (Archie, v1.0.107 cut #15). The pin is hub-v0.5.7 at oa 3140e252 (oa #487 People marker, #488 owner-career). The four delta commits are oa #486 (Lane 11/18), MEASURED per commit via the compare API: 244b244b adds gateway proxy routes the iPhone app calls (safari ingest and save, speakers/identify, conversation upload-part, forget), each behind the paired-device bearer; b4ab804d and b97a5b9b keep the gateway with no unauthenticated /api path and no service-token acceptance; ec8200f5 is test-only. They ARE customer fixes, and they are HELD to cut #16 on purpose: they ship as one unit with RemoteCapture 0.1.6 (CM051 #2735/#2736, which moves identify to :8090) and CM051 #2678 (the graft whose hub_contract.yaml is generated from them). Shipping them alone in #15 would split that unit. If #15 is the candidate Andy ships, they follow in the next cut. Re-pin to a hub built from oa main at #16 retires this row. ADDED 2026-10-09: 125094c5 and 6f5c6d9a are oa #490, the optional hub_tailnet_addr pairing-QR field, DEFAULT OFF (companion_advertise_tailnet=false) plus its default-keyset test; not a customer fix, nothing changes for a customer until the flag is on (SHARED_AUTH_SPEC §3.2.1).
